result.brief: 提出 SemanticKV：利用规划器语义约束引导的自回归视频生成 KV 缓存压缩，免训练、按约束分组打分保留关键条目，在 0.7 压缩率下保持 VBench 分数并提速 1.22 倍、显存降 3.35 倍。
result.reason: Training-free KV-cache compression for autoregressive video generation using planner semantic constraints; directly serves video generation efficiency and long-horizon controllable synthesis.
